long_biography.plain_text:
James Duff began working as a teenager at Southern Tire Mart, the Mississippi tire shop established by his father. He and his brother Thomas later ran the business, sold it, and then returned as owners when they repurchased it in 2003. Their family background supplied the platform and industry knowledge; the buyback and subsequent growth were the brothers' own operating work.

Southern Tire Mart became a nationwide commercial tire dealer and retread manufacturer, remaining the largest business in the family's portfolio. The brothers formed Duff Capital Investors in 2007 to hold a broader collection of companies in trucking, automotive retail, construction, energy and insurance. James remains an owner and operator alongside Thomas, with ownership shared between the brothers rather than assigned solely to either one. Duff Capital's revenue, fleets, dealerships, equipment, property and subsidiary assets belong to its companies, not directly to James Duff.

Duff Capital spans unrelated sectors, but Southern Tire Mart is repeatedly identified as its most valuable business, portfolio engine and the brothers' only day-to-day operating company.
